# Kresha Services

> Kresha Services is a digital marketing agency based in Chennai and Erode, Tamil Nadu, India. It helps local businesses grow with SEO, AI search optimisation (AEO and GEO), social media marketing, Google Ads, website development and graphic design, with support in Tamil and English.

Key facts:
- Locations: Chennai (main branch) and Erode (regional hub). Serves businesses across Tamil Nadu and India online. It is a service-area business: the team can meet clients at their shop, office or site.
- Languages: Tamil and English.
- Founder: Kavitha M, Founder & Digital Marketing Strategist.
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +91 93631 00998; email kreshaservices@gmail.com; Mon–Sat, 10am–7pm IST.
- Pricing: quoted after a free strategy call, itemised, with GST invoices. Packages are called Starter, Growth and Pro. No long lock-in: work starts with a 30-day roadmap and continues month to month.
- Website: https://kresha.online

## Services
- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://kresha.online/services/seo): SEO services in Chennai & Erode — local SEO, Google Business Profile optimisation and rankings that bring steady enquiries. Tamil + English.
- [AEO + GEO (AI search optimisation)](https://kresha.online/services/aeo-geo): AEO & GEO services — get your Chennai or Erode business recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and AI search engines. Structured data and AI-ready content.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://kresha.online/services/social-media-marketing): Social media marketing for Tamil Nadu businesses — content in Tamil & English that brings WhatsApp enquiries and walk-ins.
- [Google Ads](https://kresha.online/services/google-ads): Google Ads management in Chennai & Erode — targeted campaigns with full spend transparency, call and WhatsApp tracking, and trackable leads.
- [Website Development](https://kresha.online/services/website-development): Website development for Chennai & Erode businesses — fast, mobile-first, SEO-ready websites with WhatsApp integration and Google Analytics setup.
- [Graphic Design](https://kresha.online/services/graphic-design): Graphic design services — logos, festival creatives, catalogues and brand kits for businesses in Tamil Nadu. Tamil and English, print and web ready.
